The '''Toramdic Languages''' are a branch of the [[Zhensanovian Languages]] associated in source material with the eastern coast of the [[Union of Zhensanov]].

The source describes Toramdic languages as having large case systems, consonant mutation, a three-tone system, flexible word order, and an older pictographic writing system.

== Canon Limits ==

The Toramdic source details are linguistic. They should not be used to infer a fixed eastern coastal border, naval culture, or separate coastal polity without additional source support.
